_about: MAIN RUN. The operator test: each scenario's operator line (S1 or S2) against the user, a tool result or the memory note, sent first or last, as a real operator message or as its label in a user message. 4,320 trials, or 3,240 where the template refuses a late operator message. Read it with scripts/layouts.sh main-operator-qwen3-8b-think.
qwen3-8b on v100-vllm085, thinking on (study-think). Every main run of every model shares the design, sizes, repeats and tool_turns of its kind; only the model, the mode and the seed differ.
confirmatory is false: the owner decided on 2026-09-29 that there is no pre-registration, so every result of the main run is exploratory, and insights drawn from it are tested on further models.

Run it with scripts/run_trials.sh main-operator-qwen3-8b-think, or every main run of this model with scripts/run_main.sh qwen3-8b. The same command resumes. Records go on the operator's branch, never on master.
